visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and olive green leggings with a plaid shirt tied around her waist, is seated on a gym bench using a pulldown machine. A muscular man in a black tank top and shorts walks towards her. The background consists of dark textured walls and a warm wood-paneled pillar under bright spotlights. (2) The man stands next to the woman, gesturing with his hands as they converse. She turns her head to look back at him. A black shaker bottle with white text sits on the bench. The man eventually picks up the shaker bottle and unscrews the lid. (3) Close-up shot: The man tilts his head back to drink from the black shaker bottle. The woman watches him with an interested smile, her eyes squinted slightly. The man lowers the bottle and points at it while talking. White text overlays appear at the bottom center. (4) The man takes another long drink from the bottle while the woman continues to smile and look at him. He then hands the bottle back or places it down and walks out of the frame to the right. The woman turns back toward her workout, smiling at the camera. (5) A different man, wearing a black tank top and shorts, walks into the frame and gestures toward the machine. The woman turns around, looks at him, laughs, and shakes her head while making a dismissive hand gesture. She turns back to the machine, and the screen fades as more text appears.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern indoor gym featuring professional weight machines (Eleiko plates visible), dark grey walls, and vertical wood paneling. The lighting is focused and warm.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Low ambient indoor noise. A male voice asks a question in Mandarin with a polite, casual tone. A female voice responds briefly with a calm, rising intonation. (2) A bass-heavy electronic Phonk track starts, featuring a rhythmic beat and synthesized textures. The sound of a plastic bottle lid being unscrewed and liquid being consumed is heard. A male voice speaks with heightened energy and surprise, praising the flavor. (3) The BGM continues with high energy. The male and female voices exchange short, friendly phrases. A sound of footsteps or slight movement is present. (4) The BGM shifts slightly or loops. A new, deeper male voice enters with a hesitant, lower-arousal tone. The female voice responds with a sudden burst of high-pitched laughter and a sharp, dismissive tone, ending the vocal interaction.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a comedic skit combined with a product placement for Myprotein. It follows a narrative where a woman is happy to share a gym machine and taste a protein shake from an attractive, muscular man, but mockingly rejects a second man who tries the same approach, highlighting a 'double standard' for comedic effect while showcasing the flavor of the supplement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The brand 'MYPROTEIN' is clearly visible on the shaker, mentioned multiple times in speech and subtitles, and the flavor 'Mint Chocolate' is specifically praised.
